So as we did a review of our major revenues over time, looking back to 2007, 2008, up until the current year, we were able to see what happened during the great recession and how did that impact the revenues that we rely on most heavily. Really didn't see any, which was somewhat surprising. Also, our sales taxes, which is our second source of revenue, really did not see any significant decrease or decline during the great recession. Our federal revenues, which includes more than just our local revenues, all of our federal grants and things, there were some stimulus funds that happened during the great recession that significantly increased our federal revenues. We know that we have CARES funds this year that we already have heard about, but nothing to the extent that was seen during the great recession.
